SELECT
    customer_id,
    CASE WHEN region IS NULL THEN LEFT('Not_Assigned_Yet', 10) ELSE region END AS region_isnull,
    COALESCE(region, 'Not_Assigned_Yet') AS region_coalesce
FROM {{ source('legacy', 'customers') }}

SELECT
    customer_id,
    CASE WHEN region IS NULL THEN LEFT('Not_Assigned_Yet', 10) ELSE region END AS region_isnull,
    COALESCE(region, 'Not_Assigned_Yet') AS region_coalesce
FROM {{ source('legacy', 'customers') }}

explanation: This procedure copies every customer's ID and region into a new table, filling in missing regions with the placeholder "Not_Assigned_Yet" using two different functions. ISNULL cuts the placeholder down to 10 characters, because the region column is only 10 characters wide, so it is stored as "Not_Assign". COALESCE keeps the full placeholder text. The model reproduces that difference exactly and returns one row per customer.
